title: Wait and mine at Bellatrix Major Belt beside Node Gamma station: whatever regrows (thorium, palladium, iridium, carbon)
note: On trial 2026-11-15: every deposit of this belt read 0, picked clean by other pilots. The belt lies in the station's own system: no jump. Two questions: what a ship costs here per hour, and whether thorium (stations bid 240 cr) or palladium (371 cr at Node Gamma) comes back for us.
